categories.main_business_segments: Daeduck Electronics primarily operates in the manufacturing and sales of printed circuit boards (PCBs), which are essential core components in all electronic devices. The company focuses on advanced semiconductor package substrates including FCBGA, FCCSP, FCBOC, CSP, and SiP substrates, serving semiconductor and IT industries globally.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced PCB manufacturing technologies such as HDI processes, ultra-fine circuit formation (L/S below 10/10), multi-layer packaging, coreless PCB technology, and AI-integrated defect analysis systems. Production is carried out in Korea and Vietnam with a monthly average capacity of 75,500㎡, employing cutting-edge materials like low dielectric constant substrates and advanced build-up materials.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major semiconductor manufacturers and IT companies such as Samsung Electronics, SK Hynix, Amkor Technology Korea, and Stats ChipPAC Korea. The primary markets served are semiconductor memory and non-memory sectors, automotive electronics, network and inspection equipment, and emerging fields like AI, autonomous driving, and high-speed communications.
categories.geographic_coverage: Daeduck Electronics operates mainly in South Korea and Vietnam for manufacturing, with sales concentrated in South Korea, China, the United States, Taiwan, and Southeast Asia. Export sales constitute a significant portion, with 55% local exports and 41% direct exports.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates midstream in the electronics supply chain as a manufacturer of critical PCB components that connect semiconductor and passive components electrically. It supplies directly to semiconductor and electronic device manufacturers, positioning itself as a key upstream supplier of essential electronic substrates.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include continuous R&D investment focused on developing low-cost substrates, ultra-fine circuit technologies, high-density packaging substrates, coreless and thin-core PCBs, and AI-based defect analysis systems. The company emphasizes innovation in advanced semiconductor package substrates to maintain technological leadership and expand into high-value markets like AI servers and autonomous vehicles.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of printed circuit boards manufactured to customer specifications under an order-based production system. Sales are conducted via direct transactions with major domestic and international semiconductor and IT companies, with payment methods including cash, credit, and T/T for exports.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Interflex, Korea Circuit, Isu Petasys, and SEMITEC. Daeduck Electronics holds a competitive position as a specialized PCB manufacturer focusing on advanced semiconductor package substrates, leveraging technological innovation and quality to compete against both high-end producers in Japan, Korea, Taiwan and cost-competitive manufacturers in China and Southeast Asia.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated sales of approximately 909.7 billion KRW, with total assets of about 1.13 trillion KRW and equity of 868 billion KRW. Despite a 30.9% decline in sales and an 89.8% drop in operating profit compared to the previous year due to market downturns, the company maintains a solid financial structure with a low debt ratio of 29.9%. R&D expenses have steadily increased, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Daeduck Electronics differentiates itself by providing high-value, technologically advanced PCB products essential for cutting-edge semiconductor applications such as AI, autonomous driving, and high-speed communications. The company emphasizes quality, technological leadership, and close customer partnerships to deliver customized, high-performance substrates that meet evolving industry demands.
